messages.content:
You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:
Answer: <one legal option letter>
Reason: <one or two brief sentences supporting the choice>
Give the answer even when some details remain uncertain. Do not output a long reasoning trace.

content.text:
In the chest X-ray images provided, a mass is observed in the anterior mediastinum. Based on your analysis of the radiographs, which statement best describes the localization, size, and relationship of the mass in the right paracardiac region?

A) The mass is located in the left paracardiac region and appears smaller on the lateral view.
B) The mass is located in the right paracardiac region and is confined to the anterior mediastinum without invading adjacent structures.
C) The mass is located in the right paracardiac region, appears larger on the lateral view, and shows signs of potential invasion into adjacent structures.
D) The mass is located in the right paratracheal region and shows clear signs of calcification.
E) The mass is located in the left paracardiac region, appears larger on the posteroanterior view, and shows no signs of invasion.
F) The mass is located in the right paracardiac region, appears smaller on the lateral view, and is clearly calcified.
